title: Responsibilities
description: Assign or reassign who is responsible for updating records, one by one or in bulk, with a preview and a reason.
noSystems: You do not manage responsibilities in any system.

change.title: New responsible
change.confirmDescription: The records marked as allowed move now; change requests are submitted where approval is required. The previous and the new person are notified and the change is audited with your reason.
change.nothingAllowed: None of the selected records can move.

outcome.notFound: Not found or outside your scope
outcome.changedMeanwhile: Changed by someone else meanwhile — reload and try again
outcome.notEligible: This person is not eligible for this responsibility
outcome.needsChangeRequest: Needs an approved change request: one will be created and submitted
outcome.forbidden: You may not change this record
outcome.approvalRunning: An approval is already running on this record

notes.changeRequest: SPEC: the project manager / owner changes only through an approved Ownership change request. The bulk action creates and submits the change requests; nothing moves until they are approved and applied.
notes.auditOffice: Only Audit Office members can be the responsible auditor. Departments of the findings stay unchanged.
